latestHairCandidateStatus: r129 將 Blender 官方 CC0 Hair shader EEVEE 的雙色、根部加深、隨機色與噪聲機制離線複製為 AevryndOwnedLayeredHairMaterial_v249r129，採 deep-brown 自有色盤；引擎 runtime 依賴為 none，毛髮幾何與 r101/r94 balanced groom 不變。完整 11 視角及 frame 20 姿勢無新增材質破面；frame 1/20 對人體與三層服裝零穿模，五個動態狀態每狀態 224,460 個髮點與 3,946 個 rigid scalp 頂點皆零違規。50 幀 CPU profile 為 solver 9.065ms、follow 4.026ms、合計 13.091ms。髮絲與深棕色層次明顯優於 r101 的黑色塊，但前額 scalp carrier 仍像塗色補片、分線過寬、髮際偏高且根部過度平行；只升為毛髮材質技術候選，不取代 r38 或網站 v83。
latestHairMaterialStudy: r129 deep-brown Aevrynd-owned derivative of Blender official CC0 Hair shader EEVEE; material, collision, dynamic and performance gates passed; strict hairline/face display gate failed
latestEyeCandidateStatus: r109 replaces the 32mm-wide translucent red tear planes that crossed the irises with two evaluated-lower-lid mesh arcs: 37 points, 222 vertices, 218 faces and 60um radius per eye. Alternating frame 1/20 projection keeps a 0.22mm body clearance; both new layers have zero body intersections at both frames, all other face layers have no regression, the 11-shot review has no new breakage, and five dynamic hair states remain at zero violations. The visible iris obstruction is removed, but lid anatomy and corneal response still fail the strict overall display threshold, so the public website remains v83.
latestFaceCandidateStatus: editable topology-based philtrum smoothing shape key reduces face self-intersections from 102/99 to 95/91 at frames 1/20 and reduces lip/wet-line overlaps; 11-shot and five-state dynamic audits pass, but the visible gain remains local and strict overall review remains about 52/100, so it is not promoted
latestSkinCandidateStatus: r75 calibrated skin response and fine-pore microrelief baked into an owned packed 4096x2048 tangent normal atlas; visual A/B, 11-shot, frame 1/20 static, and five-state 1,500,400-point dynamic audits pass, but strict overall visual review remains about 52/100 and is not promoted
latestRejectedExperiment: r165–r168 scalp/crown clump generation and EEVEE hair shader calibration
latestRejectedReason: r165 adds 2,800 scalp clumps/39,200 points and passes frame 1/20 collision, but creates a wet fringe across the forehead. r166 restricts 1,800 clumps/25,200 points to the crown and keeps the 202,553-point total collision-safe; visual gain is too small. r167 identifies the EEVEE branch as metallic 0.786, SSS 1.0 Principled plus Translucent; surface-only nonmetal variants turn gray and plastic. r168 retains the translucent combination and sweeps metallic/roughness; 0.60/0.58 slightly reduces white ribbons while preserving brown, but overlapping linework and sparse root flow remain. None are promoted.

latestHairScalpCandidateStatus: r163 derives a clean scalp shell from the same shaped body surface, copies all 21 skin-weight groups and Armature deformation, excludes the concave temple crease, and keeps 1.2mm authored clearance. Its 2,626 vertices/2,438 faces and r162 177,353-point pruned curly layer pass frame 1/20 collision checks against body and all three clothing solids. It reduces crown exposure but still fails strict overall hair appearance, so it is a scalp deformation/collision technical candidate only.
